_comment: Truthful wording rules for template bullets, read by pipeline.py. 'when' rules move a verified bullet into a job's vocabulary when the job asks for one of those concepts; 'repair' rules restate a rejected template bullet in the master profile's own words. Every result is verified against the master profile again and must fit on one line (no longer than the template's longest bullet), so a rule can never add a fact.
